items.title: Play a game at a house party
items.text: Start Connect Four, garden chess, Ludo or pool at any house party. The board goes up outside: on a glass deck over the pool, on the lawn, or on a terrace beside a flat. Any guest can join, and everyone else watches, cheers and predicts the winner.
items.how: At a party: 🎉 Party → 🎲 Let's play. Tap the board itself to play. 👀 Watch takes you to it.

items.title: Slide round your house with two fingers
items.text: On a phone, one finger turns the view and two fingers slide it, so you can see the pool, the garden or a party game round the side of the house.
items.how: In your home, put two fingers on the screen and slide. Or tap a stop on the bar at the bottom (Pool, Garden, Game).

items.title: Bur Dubai and Deira are on the map
items.text: Old Dubai is open, behind Dubai Frame: Al Fahidi, Meena Bazaar, BurJuman and Dubai Courts in Bur Dubai, and across the creek by abra, the Gold Souk, the Spice Souk and City Centre Deira.
items.how: Scroll the map past Dubai Frame. Take the abra across the creek.

items.title: Haggle at the Gold Souk
items.text: Gold is sold by weight at the day's rate. Check the hallmark, use the magnet on fakes and talk the merchant down, or run a stall yourself and sell to tourists.
items.how: Map → Deira → Dubai Gold Souk → Damas, Joyalukkas or Malabar.

items.title: Take a case to Dubai Courts
items.text: Cross-examine witnesses, present your evidence and win the judgment over deposits, fines, scams and wages. You can also work the marriage registry.
items.how: Map → Bur Dubai → Dubai Courts.

items.title: Pregnancy scans and giving birth
items.text: Expecting? Book your scans at Latifa Women and Children Hospital or Dubai Hospital, then go into labour in the delivery suite. Coach the breathing and push at the peaks for a healthy start.
items.how: Map → Bur Dubai → Latifa Hospital, or Deira → Dubai Hospital.

items.title: Train at the gym
items.text: Run on the treadmill, row and hit the heavy bag. Training builds your strength and stamina, and they count in the boxing ring.
items.how: Fitness First (BurJuman or Dubai Marina Mall), or UFC Gym on JBR's The Walk.

items.title: Celebrity boxing
items.text: Challenge someone to a celebrity boxing match: jab, hook, block and counter in a 3D ring. The fitter you are from the gym, the harder you hit.
items.how: At a party: 🎉 Party → 🥊 Boxing. Or train at UFC Gym JBR.

items.title: Book an event hall for your wedding
items.text: Hotels have ballrooms for weddings, birthdays and more. Book the hall, hire a player decorator or dress it yourself, and your guests walk in live from the invite for the zaffa, the first dance, the cake and the bouquet.
items.how: Map → Bur Dubai → Grand Hyatt Dubai → Baniyas Ballroom, or any hotel with an event hall.

items.title: Find your wedding outfit
items.text: Try gowns, lehengas and sherwanis on the podium, say yes to the one, then pin the alterations. You can also work as a bridal consultant.
items.how: Map → Bur Dubai → Meena Bazaar → Manyavar & Mohey.

items.title: Paint your nails
items.text: Shape every nail, paint inside the lines, add French tips, glitter or gems and cure them under the UV lamp. The set goes on your look, or you can work as a nail technician for tips.
items.how: NStyle at The Dubai Mall or City Centre Deira, or The Nail Spa at Dubai Marina Mall.

items.title: Decorate your ceiling
items.text: The roof now shows in the Inside and Eye views. Pick a finish (tray, coffered, beams, arabesque or a starry sky) and a paint colour.
items.how: Home → Menu → Decorate, then pick a ceiling beside the floors and walls.

items.title: The Dubai Life Marathon, every Friday
items.text: Run together with everyone at 7pm Dubai time past Burj Khalifa, Sheikh Zayed Road and the Museum of the Future. Free to enter; the top 3 win AED 50,000, 25,000 and 10,000.
items.how: Phone → Marathon → Sign up, then invite your friends with your link.

items.title: Go for a run
items.text: Run out of your front door along City Walk, the JBR Beach Walk or round the block, and back home.
items.how: Home → Rituals → Go for a run.

items.title: Love, proposals and weddings
items.text: Ask a friend out, go on dates, propose with a ring at Burj Al Arab, and plan a wedding with a guest list, bridesmaids and a best man. Guests send gifts and you both say "I do" live.
items.how: Phone → Family. Share your wedding invitation link so friends can RSVP.

items.title: Doctors, police and courts
items.text: Get ill and see a doctor, get arrested over a suspicious transfer and hire a lawyer, or become the doctor, officer or lawyer yourself. Every job now starts with an interview.
items.how: Phone → Dubai Health, Dubai Police or Jobs.

items.title: Order food, groceries and rides
items.text: Yalla Eats, Cluck Shack, Golden Bun, Daily Basket and Yalla Ride are on your phone. Food is delivered wherever you are and fills you up.
items.how: Tap the phone beside Profile in the bottom bar, then any of the new apps on the first row.

items.title: A new phone and a cleaner map
items.text: Your phone now opens right over the map with all your apps. Tap the arrow at the top for the time, your mood, streak, wallet and music.
items.how: Tap the phone beside Profile in the bottom bar. Tap any place on the map to read about it and see who's there before you go.

items.title: Invite friends to your home
items.text: Send a friend a link to your door from any chat. They go on your guest list and can walk straight in.
items.how: Phone → Messages → open a chat → 🏠 Invite to my home.

items.title: Duplexes, townhouses and luxury interiors
items.text: Two-storey homes with stairs you can climb, grand pianos, chandeliers, fireplaces and aquariums. Restyle floors, walls and panelling.
items.how: Open Home, then the ✨ Style tab. Tap the stairs to go up.

items.title: Metro announcements on phones
items.text: The Red Line voice now speaks on iPhone and Android, in English and Arabic.
items.how: Take the metro from any station on the map with your sound on.
